messages:
Alex: Heads-up — seeing a ~30% p95/p99 tail latency spike on int8 canary after merge #4123. Seems related to the kernel selector change + dequant inlining. Observed on serving-prod-canary-2.

Priya: ugh. any repro logs or flamegraphs? Can we bisect to a single commit?

Alex: capturing a small perf profile and traces now. Quick dump:
```
hotspots:
  - decode loop: dequant_to_fp (heavy)
  - KV cache evictions spike when seq_len > 512
  - kernel chosen for these shapes: conv_fused_int8_v2 (new selector path)
```

Jules: I ran a short microbenchmark on the same model+seq distribution. I can reproduce locally: the selector picks conv_fused_int8_v2 which avoids a memcpy but relies on inlined dequant on the hotloop. The allocator/kvcache pattern causes more mem pressure -> extra eviction latency.

Nina: Confirmed on canary logs — there are repeated KV cache misses aligned with the dequant inlining op (looks like we changed the order of loads in 0fd3a9f). That commit moved selector heuristics earlier in the pipeline.

ci-bot: Perf alert triggered for branch: release/2026. Test: runtime/p95_latency_int8_canary. Link: https://ci.redwood.example/perf/alerts/2981 :warning:

Marta: Can we try forcing the old kernel selector as a quick canary rollback? e.g. SVC_KERNEL_SELECTOR=legacy for that slot.

Alex: Good call. Spinning a canary with SVC_KERNEL_SELECTOR=legacy now. Also kicking off a git bisect to isolate offending commit range between 0f3a.. and 4123.

Priya: If it narrows to the selector reorder, we should revert only the selector reordering and keep other fixes. We should avoid a full revert.

Jules: Quick local patch that disables dequant inlining on the decode hotpath reduced p99 by ~25% in my run. Patch snippet: 
```diff
- if (can_inline_dequant) inline_dequant();
+ // avoid inlining on hot decode path until kvcache behavior is verified
+ if (false && can_inline_dequant) inline_dequant();
```

Nina: That matches the trace. Dequant inlining increased working set which amplified kvcache evictions. With inlining off, eviction count drops ~3x.

ops-bot: Holding rollout to production for release/2026 in region us-west-2 until perf alert is cleared.

Alex: Action plan:
- (Alex) finish bisect and post commit range by EOD
- (Jules) open a small revert PR for the inlining portion if bisect points to it
- (Priya) run canary with SVC_KERNEL_SELECTOR=legacy and attach perf dashboard
- (Nina) collect KV cache metrics and eviction traces for 24h

Priya: Also thinking about a longer-term fix: make kernel selector consider incremental working-set delta (est. added pages) rather than just op cost. Should reduce these regressions when memory footprint shifts.

Alex: Agree. For now prioritize targeted revert/guard and a config knob for selector ordering.

ci-bot: Perf test queue updated: runtime/p95_latency_int8_canary (rerun in ~15m).

Marta: Thanks — will standby to promote the canary once metrics look stable. :thumbsup:

Alex: I'll post the bisect result when done. Thanks everyone.
